summary: A bright, playful variable-font site for a three-axis grotesk (weight, width, italic plus a Mono). It opens with a Pong game in which the CTA buttons are the paddles and every hit re-flexes the name. Short design-aspect tiles with looping videos follow, then giant collapsible axis headers that open onto words animated to act out their meaning ('Squat', 'Rattle', 'Dip', 'Slouch'). A colour-coded appendix closes the page, and the tester lives in a side drawer behind a vertical 'TYPETESTER' tab.

instances.variantDefinition: The hero is a small playable game (e.g. Pong) built from the page's own elements: collisions or score change the name's axes or style, and CTA buttons can double as game pieces

instances.ux: The two CTA buttons are Pong paddles sliding along the top and bottom edges; the yellow ball bounces between them, and each hit on the name changes its width, weight and italic (frames show it condensed upright, wide roman, wide italic). The paddles stay clickable links
instances.learn: Turn the obligatory buy/trial buttons into game pieces: the CTA is the first thing visitors play with, and every bounce shows a new point in the design space
